name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible as users scroll or zoom, so they never lose context. The trade-off is screen space—we shrink the graph area—but clarity wins over compactness when users need to reference the legend constantly.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still steals 15% of screen at all zoom levels—users miss the graph entirely. Instead, make the legend a floating collapsed icon that expands on hover or click, saving space while keeping it accessible. Test both: if users reference the legend more than 3 times per session, the floating icon fails; if fewer than 2, the sticky panel is wasteful.
